source_record.facts: Orphaned Caine spent ten years of his life prioritizing his five mates in Rejecting My Five Female Mates. They were his foster father’s beloved daughters—spoiled, cherished, and fearless in their own ways. They became the anchor of his existence, and for so long, he thought one of them would become his fated mate. Everything changed when Seth, a notorious rogue, came onto the scene. Blinded by Seth’s lies, the five female mates turned against Caine, relentlessly humiliating him and constantly challenging his honor as the next-in-line alpha of the pack. Their treatment of Caine eventually became more than he could bear. Rather than stay and endure another humiliation, he left the pack and looked elsewhere for a future. His search took him to a foreign pack, where a marriage alliance brought him together with Princess Sylvia. He didn’t expect to fall for her so quickly, but he did. Caine thought leaving would put the worst behind him, but his life with Sylvia soon ran into trouble. One problem followed another, testing a relationship that had only just begun. Still, they refused to turn against each other and managed to get through it. For a brief moment, their future finally looked secure. That was until his five female mates crashed their wedding, demanding to settle the score and begging him to take them back. Would Caine accept their apology, or would it be the last time they ever brought up the past? Characters Caine Caine is the central character of Rejecting My Five Female Mates. He’s resilient, compassionate, and humble, always acting out of honor and always determined to fight for the truth. Enduring the hardships eventually pays off when he discovers a place where no one can doubt him again. Princess Sylvia Princess Sylvia is the reigning princess of the Silvermoon Pack. She’s mature, morally upright, and perceptive, exactly the kind of traits that match Caine’s personality. No wonder fate brought them together and allowed them to live happily ever after. Seth Seth is the notorious rogue who lies his way into the five female mates’ hearts. He creates stories to attack Caine’s character, believing they would be enough to get everything Caine has. His schemes fall through when Caine exposes him and he is punished for his sins.

In Fiancée's Betrayal Dante's Inferno movie, Dante Bosch returns home after 3 years in the Marine Raiders on a top secret mission, only to discover not only is his fiancée Lilith pregnant with his brother Virgil's baby, but Virgil has also spent all his money. To add insult to injury, his parents take Virgil's side. After suffering betrayals and humiliations, Dante exposes Virgil's lies with a video at his wedding.

She came to town for a fresh start. Instead, Penelope Harris got pregnant by her ex’s powerful older brother, Knox Grant– the rugged cowboy who owns the ranch where she works. Now Penelope is caught between the man who would burn the world down for her and her ex, who wants to see her burn.

Marcus, a warlord who controls America’s economy and weapons, attends his brother Reed’s wedding. Mistaken for a delivery worker because of his mission uniform, he is looked down upon by the fiancée and her family. As a result, Marcus tries to set Reed up with the famous 'Three Goddesses of America,' but no one would believe him and they humiliate him. Reed defends him, so the fiancée’s family turns on Reed — she publicly dumps him to marry her ex instead, who has secretly been bankrupting Reed's business. Enraged, Marcus strikes back and humiliates them all. Only then do they learn his true identity—and regret it too late.

title: My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire

source_record.facts: In My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire movie, Archer is nowhere to be seen on his wedding with Alice—rumor has it he died in an explosion during a firefighting mission. Alice’s greedy parents try to marry her off to a sleazy suitor, Philip. At the new wedding, Alice finally sees her husband again—but he’s now engaged to someone else.
source_record.platform_title: My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire

title: Accidentally His: The Dragon King Won't Let Go

source_record.facts: In Accidentally His The Dragon King Won't Let Go movie, on a Blood Moon night, a drunken human girl steps into a cabin where the Dragon King lies in heat. After a steamy night with him, her belly suddenly swells, terrifying her into fleeing and leaving the loyal Dragon King to believe she has abandoned him. Days later, fate brings them together again, only for him to discover that she remembers nothing about him! But wait... is she secretly raising a child with horns all by herself?
source_record.platform_title: Accidentally His: The Dragon King Won't Let Go

source_record.facts: In Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant movie, everyone's always told Nora to keep her head down and stay silent, but there's one exception — Vince Grant, her husband. As their contract marriage comes to an end after the best year of her life, Nora is faced with returning to her abusive family, who are already plotting to marry her off again. Always the calm, collected CEO, Vince finds himself desperate for a chance to win Nora over, even though she left him without looking back. He watches Nora shrink back into the shell he spent a year coaxing her out of, and decides enough is enough. Whether it's as the best "ex-husband" the world's ever seen, or Nora's real husband, with no contract between them, he'll protect her with everything he has.

title: Take Me Back to the Night We Met

source_record.facts: A lifetime ago, figure skating prodigy Gwen Tyler was at the top of her game and on her way to Olympic gold. But ten years later, she's stuck in a loveless engagement and a shadow of her former self. Then, her childhood best friend Aaron Lansing comes back into her life after a decade apart, and Gwen starts to realize... maybe the love she's been missing is the one she had when she was eighteen. Now she has to decide whether she's just going to keep letting life happen to her, or take back control for herself.
source_record.platform_title: Take Me Back to the Night We Met

source_record.facts: In God of Pain movie, a sheltered mafia princess tries to escape an arranged marriage, only to fall for the school’s most dangerous bad boy. But he refuses to love her… Until he can’t let her go.

title: How to Wreck My Bully's Heart

source_record.facts: In How to Wreck My Bully's Heart movie, Kristina Cooper's a scholarship student by day, online masked singer by night. She's got the perfect internet boyfriend in Dax – sweet, caring, and supportive – until she finds out he's Daxter, the monsterous thug who's been bullying her at school! Will she forgive Dexter, the damaged, broken boy she once loved, or will their anonymous love end in Dexter's never ending regret as Kristina choses a brighter future without him?
source_record.platform_title: How to Wreck My Bully's Heart

title: The Double Life of My Ex-Con Husband

source_record.facts: The heir of a wealthy family, Lucas, voluntarily went to prison to overthrow his half brother. His fiancée abandoned him and went to live with his half brother. After being released from prison, he concealed his wealthy identity and entered into a contractual marriage with the orphaned girl, Ava. Gradually, true feelings developed between them. Ava discovered that she was the long-lost heiress of a rich family. When her old enemies came after her, Lucas revealed his true identity and embarked on a desperate revenge to help her.
source_record.platform_title: The Double Life of My Ex-Con Husband

source_record.facts: A serving of street‑market food. A security guard named Ethan Carter. A chance encounter with Grace Harrington, CEO of the Uleah Group. Then came the freak electrical accident—and the dormant cultivation power passed down from his grandfather Frederick Whitaker roared awake. Now Ethan doesn't bow to the Whitakers. He doesn't kneel to the Harringtons. Names, titles, legacies—none of it matters. There's only one law he answers to: strength. His fists? They're the final argument.

In Nothing Escapes My Eyes movie, Liam is a delivery driver cuckolded by his gold-digging girlfriend. One day, he gets hit by a car belonging to Ivy, a gorgeous CEO. From the accident, he gains the superpower of "God's Sight', allowing him to see how much time is left in people’s lives, as well as the true value of things.

title: The Barren Alpha Knocked Me Up with Twins

source_record.facts: Kaelen, the strongest Alpha of his werewolf clan, struggles with fertility. His grandfather arranges a marriage with the Chris family to secure an heir. Chris, mistreated at home, flees and works at a bar, where she is drugged and has a one-night stand with Kaelen, resulting in pregnancy. Kaelen's assistant discovers the pregnancy and informs him. When Chris returns home to borrow money from her stepmother, she is mocked, but Kaelen arrives to rescue her, takes her to the hospital, and insists she keep the baby, promising to protect her.Kaelen punishes the bullies' families. Chris gives birth, and the family lives happily ever after.
source_record.platform_title: The Barren Alpha Knocked Me Up with Twins

title: Her Man Is the Son of Death

source_record.facts: Lucas Thorne, a powerful demigod disguised as a beggar finally finds love with a mafia heiress who accepts him at his lowest—but when danger closes in, he must reveal his true identity to protect her, risking the secret he was bound to keep.
source_record.platform_title: Her Man Is the Son of Death

title: I Ditched My Ex and Had Five Babies with His Alpha Dad

source_record.facts: In I Ditched My Ex and Had Five Babies with His Alpha Dad movie, killed by Ethan, Vivienne is reborn five years prior. She chooses Richard, Ethan's father and the clan's strongest Alpha. A fated red thread proves them true mates. Carrying his five pups, she passes the Spirit Stele trial, earns divine blessing, and strips Ethan of his title. Ethan takes forbidden drugs, becomes a monster, and kidnaps her. As she falls into the sea, the Ice Lotus awakens the pups' power, lifting them on a golden lotus. Richard slays Ethan, and they wed amid a moonlit flower sea.
source_record.platform_title: I Ditched My Ex and Had Five Babies with His Alpha Dad

source_record.facts: In Altarboy movie, after getting kicked out for being gay, 18-year-old Theo is dumped at a Catholic church to be "cured" — and finds his new priest is young, hot... and a huge jerk who makes Theo his personal altar boy. What starts as a game of temptation becomes a slow-burn obsession neither can pray away, but as the game turns real, both Theo and Alexander risk losing everything to a love neither of them is supposed to want.

Thrown into the freezing rain by her mobster husband for being "fat and worthless," Hannah is left with nothing. Desperate for shelter, she accepts a midnight emergency call to nanny for a traumatized toddler. She arrives at a breathtaking estate, only to discover her new employer is Don Lucian Moretti—New York’s most feared mafia kingpin. While her ex replaced her with a cruel social climber, the legendary boss offers her respect, a million-dollar life, and a unyielding protection. When her ex begs on his knees, it’s too late. The rejected wife is now the Mafia Queen.

The AC dies in the middle of a brutal summer, leaving Becca trapped upstairs with the one person she should never want—her stepbrother. While their mom is just one creaking staircase away, every stolen glance and accidental touch pushes them closer to a line they can never uncross. What begins as a simple repair turns into a dangerous game of temptation, secrets, and forbidden desire. In a house where they must pretend nothing is happening, resisting each other may be the hardest thing they’ve ever done.

Karter, the legendary Poker King lost everything when he reported Aaron for money laundering 3 years ago. He was rescued by Elena, the daughter of a small casino's owner. When Aaron returns to put Elena and the casino in danger, Karter gives up his disguise as a humble waiter, and reveals his true identity.

title: I Married the Alpha They Threw Away

source_record.facts: After being betrayed by her Alpha mate and watching him lead the pack to slaughter both her and her newborn daughter, Lyra is given a second life. This time, she rejects fate, chooses a new mate, and awakens the legendary White Wolf. As the truth behind the pureblood bloodline unravels, the Alpha realizes he destroyed the very bloodline his family hunted for generations. But when Lyra becomes pregnant again, the hunt begins once more.
source_record.platform_title: I Married the Alpha They Threw Away

source_record.facts: Scarlett, a kind‑hearted and resilient delivery rider, enters a flash marriage with Ethan, the CEO of Imperial Group who is disgui

title: Reborn, I Gave Birth to the True Dragon King's Twins

source_record.facts: Pierce threw Sloane's newborn into lava, carved out her dragon heart-core, and left her to die on the storm altar. Reborn seven years earlier, Sloane watches him choose her sister, convinced Mira will bear the golden heir Sloane never could. She lets him walk into his own ruin and binds herself to Corvin, a cursed raven everyone mocks. Then Mira's golden egg hatches a black serpent, while Sloane's single egg reveals twins: a Supreme Gold Dragon and a Blackwing royal. Pierce was only a serpent in stolen scales, and the raven he despised was the true Dragon King.
source_record.platform_title: Reborn, I Gave Birth to the True Dragon King's Twins

source_record.facts: In the King of War Tech movie, Wesley Creed, the King of War Tech, hides his identity in order to keep his dead squadmates' research alive, only to be treated like dirt. 3 years later, he's ready to reclaim his identity.

In Bound by the Past movie, 8 years after Dante took a bullet for Valentina, a mafia war rages between Chicago and Las Vegas. With a world of bloodshed knocking on their door, they must decide how to protect their daughter, and their marriage.

Tim Harper is secretly Titan, but at school he's a bullied new kid. His powers keep nearly slipping out, and Sarah suspects his double life. Their bond grows through a talent show and a scholarship contest run by billionaire Blackwell, secretly Tim's mentor. Confessing his secret costs Tim his powers. Mayor Hunter and Jax frame him at a gala, and a blast nearly kills everyone. Powerless, Tim risks his life anyway, regains his powers, and flies off with Sarah as the villains are arrested.

title: Race and Rise: My Machine Girls

source_record.facts: In the Mecha Age, girls who turn 18 can transform into powerful mechas and go to the battlefield, while men can become Pilots and lead them to glory in combat. Ethan awakens as an SSS-rank Pilot. Waiting for him are beautiful Mecha Girls, each with her own unique personality, advanced combat skills, ever-evolving weapons and energy systems. But every victory only leads him to more challenges, where even his SSS-rank power will be put to the ultimate test. As his enemies go after him, Ethan must grow stronger, master his Mecha Girls, and fight his way toward the top.
source_record.platform_title: Race and Rise: My Machine Girls

title: Super Godfather 2: My Ex Dumped the Wrong Man

source_record.facts: Cain Hunter, heir to the almighty Godfather, is back! He'll fight past mind-controlling schemers and threats haunting the shadows, whatever it takes to pass the ten trials his grandfather has set for him. But what if it all comes at a cost? What if it means losing the love of his life, Annalise?
source_record.platform_title: Super Godfather 2: My Ex Dumped the Wrong Man

source_record.facts: After three years of fighting on the northern front, legendary dragon rider Kalen Gerard returns home, ready to marry the woman he has loved for years. Instead, he finds his castle occupied, his fiancée pregnant with another man's child, and his family legacy stolen by a shameless usurper. Branded a worthless nobody, Kalen is ordered to give up his title, his home, and even raise his fiancée's illegitimate child. But no one knows the truth—he is the kingdom's greatest war hero, the man who slew the Black Dragon and saved humanity.

title: The Billion-Dollar Heir's Six-Year Secret Bride

source_record.facts: Ethan Voss, heir to the ultra‑wealthy Voss conglomerate, fell in love with Clara, an ordinary girl, under a concealed identity. He was left comatose after a car accident and vanished for six years. Clara held fast on her own, gave birth to their daughter, and scraped by on odd‑job work. Upon regaining consciousness, Ethan made behind‑the‑scenes arrangements to make amends to his beloved. He threw a lavish top‑tier wedding to humiliate his snobbish relatives, finally revealed his true identity, and walked hand‑in‑hand with Clara toward a happy ending.
source_record.platform_title: The Billion-Dollar Heir's Six-Year Secret Bride

source_record.facts: On her first day at Maple Elite Academy, transfer student Emma Parker does the unthinkable — she picks a fight with The Big Four, the untouchable heirs who rule the school. Tyrannical Rowan Calloway wants to break her. Golden-boy August Langford wants to protect her. But behind their masks, nothing is what it seems. The closer they get, the harder they fall — for the girl who was never meant to belong in their world. Enemies… or childhood friends? When it comes to Rowan and August, the answer is never simple. Who will she choose?

title: The Scarred Orc Who Bit Me First

source_record.facts: My Pureblood husband won't touch me. He sleeps in my stepsister's wing. So I bought a wrecked half-blind mongrel Orc on a curb for five grand. By dawn, his bond mark was on my throat. By morning, three Highborn uncles were at my door. Turns out the "low-grade" Orc I just bought is the lost heir to an eight-hundred-million-dollar Drennan estate. And every relative in that house paid to disfigure his face when he was eight. They're about to find out what I do to people who hurt what's mine.
source_record.platform_title: The Scarred Orc Who Bit Me First

source_record.facts: Billion-dollar conglomerate founder Sarah returns home, keeping her wealth hidden, hoping only for a quiet wedding. Unexpectedly,

title: My Fiancé Betrayed Me, So I Bankrupted Him

source_record.facts: Minutes before her engagement, Manhattan's richest heiress catches her fiancé in bed with the scholarship student she personally sponsored. He humiliates her in front of the entire city, believing love has finally defeated money. Instead of begging, Sera unleashes the contracts that built his empire. Frozen assets, federal investigations, and billion-dollar lawsuits turn his dream into a nightmare. But when he realizes the woman he betrayed was the only reason he ever stood at the top, it is already too late.
source_record.platform_title: My Fiancé Betrayed Me, So I Bankrupted Him

source_record.facts: Selene, the noble Lycan Princess, loved the East Coast Alpha Caleb for eighteen years, only to be betrayed, drained of her blood, and brutally murdered by him and his Omega lover, Elara, in her past life. Miraculously reborn on the night of the Blood Moon Altar, Selene refuses to make the same mistake. Instead of Caleb, she chooses Kael, an Alpha bound by a dark witch's curse. Forced to endure Caleb's arrogant humiliations and cruelties under the temporary effects of a secrecy potion, Selene patiently bides her time. With Kael ultimately breaking his curse to become an unmatched ancient Lycan, will Selene successfully rewrite her tragic fate, expose the traitors, and claim her throne as the ultimate Lycan Queen?

title: I Faked My Death To Ruin My Mafia Husband

source_record.facts: "You're lying." That's what my husband said when I begged him to save me. Six months pregnant, I was kidnapped, beaten, and left to lose our baby—while he chose his mistress over me again and again. So I gave him exactly what he deserved: my death. Now he thinks he buried his wife and daughter. But I'm still alive... and this time, I'll bury everything he loves.
source_record.platform_title: I Faked My Death To Ruin My Mafia Husband

source_record.facts: Tana is the LAST fire dragon alive—and she's hiding that secret in a cage where the losers DIE. Every night Tana heals Cedric, the wolf king locked beside her, never knowing he's her fated mate. But the second Cedric marks her and finds out she's no wolf, he LEAVES her—pregnant and alone. Now Tana is raising Cedric's secret daughter in the city… while Cedric tears apart every mountain looking for the mate he threw away.

title: My Telepathic Pup Made Me Luna

source_record.facts: Maeve is a defective Omega with no Wolf Spirit, a slum scavenger who once trusted her toxic friend Faye, swallowed wolfsbane, lost her unborn child, and died in flames set by Knox’s noble first love, Blair. Reborn on the night Alpha King Knox seeks her as the cure to his dark curse, Maeve hears the fierce little voice of her unborn telepathic pup and finally makes the smart choice: accept the Moonstones, the black card, and her place inside the Pack House. With her pup warning her of every trap, Maeve trains, wins the Queen Mother’s heart, exposes Faye and Blair, proves her child is pureblood, and rises from rejected Omega to Luna Queen.
source_record.platform_title: My Telepathic Pup Made Me Luna

source_record.facts: A modern romantic psychological thriller in the tone of Fifty Shades of Grey and Secretary, Assistant is dark, seductive, outrageously thought-provoking, and riveting. Directorial debut of genre filmmaker Louisa Warren (Cannibal Cabin, Hard Copy).

title: Blind No Longer: My Wife's Betrayal

source_record.facts: Two years ago, a car accident left me blind. My sense of sight finally returned to me one day... and the very first thing I saw... was my wife cheating on me.
source_record.platform_title: Blind No Longer: My Wife's Betrayal

source_record.facts: After catching her boyfriend cheating with her best friend at a college party, Vera accidentally falls into a pool and wakes up in Ancient Egypt. Branded an outsider and hunted for her mysterious origins, she's rescued by Prince Amon, who discovers she carries the blood of an ancient god. As a power-hungry queen plots to use Vera's divine bloodline to seize the throne, Vera and Amon are drawn into a deadly game of palace intrigue, betrayal, and forbidden love. Just when Vera finally finds a way back home, the person she trusts most is killed. Choosing revenge over escape, she embraces the godlike power within her—but the truth behind her bloodline could destroy everything Ancient Egypt was built on.

title: Forbidden Night with the Mafia Heir

source_record.facts: Vince buried his past with Dante, the mob heir who vanished five years ago. When Dante returns, he's still reckless, still devastating, still determined to win Vince back. But Leo, the fragile younger brother Vince saved, wants him too. Caught between two brothers, Vince must decide if the man who broke him once is worth the risk again.
source_record.platform_title: Forbidden Night with the Mafia Heir

title: The Alpha Made His Savior the Pack's Slave

source_record.facts: Aria Voss lost her voice and scarred her face dragging Alpha Damon Kade out of a wolfsbane fire. Three years later, Damon believes Vivienne, the woman wearing Aria's stolen pendant, is his savior. He calls Aria a liar, gives her to his warriors as a reward, and ties her to the border for execution. Aria has no voice, no wolf, and no pack left to trust. Then Frostfang's Caleb cuts her free. With her voice returning and her pendant back in hand, Aria walks into Blackthorn as Ravyn Vale to expose the fraud and reject the Alpha who ruined her.
source_record.platform_title: The Alpha Made His Savior the Pack's Slave

title: Oops! My Fake Husband Got Me Pregnant!

source_record.facts: A broke young woman agrees to be a stranger's wife for ninety days to save her brother from prison — only to learn her "husband" is the billionaire who has spent seventeen years searching for the girl who once saved his life.
source_record.platform_title: Oops! My Fake Husband Got Me Pregnant!

title: I Secretly Gave Birth to God's Five Babies

source_record.facts: On a stormy night, during a divine rebellion, the drugged King of Gods Zeus stumbles into the restaurant of the mortal chef Ruby. After a passionate night, he leaves behind a silver ring and disappears. Ruby gives birth to five adorable demigod children and raises them alone. Eight years later, Zeus returns as the billionaire CEO Alexander, while the five powerful kids secretly test their absentee father. The jealous goddess Amelia teams up with Hades to hunt down the family. In their darkest hour, Zeus fights valiantly while the children awaken their divine powers to protect their mother. With the crisis resolved, Zeus kneels before his mortal wife in the divine realm, making her a solemn promise.
source_record.platform_title: I Secretly Gave Birth to God's Five Babies

title: I Gave Birth to the Strongest Alpha Werewolf King

source_record.facts: Falsely condemned to bear only lowly mongrels, Moonwolf she‑wolf Aurora is viciously harmed by her husband and clan leader Tristan. Reborn on the day of the political marriage, she hears the hateful prophecy again and watches Tristan wed her sister to produce a noble Silverwolf. On a full‑moon night, Aurora slips into Moonillusion Bar and surrenders herself to the trapped, heat‑stricken ancient wolf god Fenrir for a child. Their fiery night frees Fenrir from his thousand‑year bonds. He shocks everyone by claiming the pregnant Aurora as his bride. She delivers a supreme wolf king. Her powerful bloodline erases every disgrace. The traitor and her scheming sister kneel in defeat. Aurora changes her fate and gains unmatched glory.
source_record.platform_title: I Gave Birth to the Strongest Alpha Werewolf King

title: All the Words I Never Said

source_record.facts: Ten years ago Layla's parents died pulling Elias Cole out of a burning building. She watched it happen, and the trauma took all five of her senses. Sight came back. Hearing and speech never did. Elias learned sign language for her and made her a promise: he'd be her eyes, her ears, her voice, and show her the whole world. The Coles raised her. The whole school knew whose girl she was. Then a transfer student named Molly turns the school into a game, and in the boys' bathroom Layla's hearing comes back — just in time to learn that Elias has been on the other side of that game for a long time. She says nothing. She lets them keep talking, keep escalating, keep filming, while a recorder collects every voice, every insult, every line about a cripple who can't call for help. She takes the beatings, the wastewater tank, the broken ribs, and she keeps the file. Molly is going to hear her own voice played back to her. And when Elias finally turns around and starts breaking things to make it up to her, Layla will already be on a plane, with an uncle who has been waiting ten years for her call, learning to say her first word out loud.
source_record.platform_title: All the Words I Never Said

source_record.facts: Amber Ryder, a rugged horse breeder, is forced to sell her most dangerous stallion to billionaire polo heir, Henry Harding to keep her father's ranch afloat. Amber doubts if Henry has the grit to tame this wild stallion, but as they train the difficult horse, they realize the real fight isn't the horse... it's each other. Will these two horse-lovers rein in their desires… or let the flames of passion burn brighter?

Odysseus is the secret demigod son of Apollo, bound by a deathbed vow to give his queen, Antigone, a hundred chances to earn his trust — and never seize her throne. He turns white-haired overnight saving her kingdom from a monster, only to catch her in another man's arms. Stripped of power, tortured, framed, betrayed again and again — every wrong she commits burns away one more chance. When the hundredth chance runs out, his true power awakens. He returns for vengeance, spear blazing with divine fire — but victory comes at the ultimate price: his own existence.

Forced into marriage by her scheming grandmother and sister, Natalia becomes the wife of Leonardo, a rugged rural rancher and devoted single father to his mute daughter, Lilly. Unwanted by both Lilly and a hostile neighbor, Natalia struggles to find her place—until she uncovers the neighbor's abuse of the little girl. As she earns Lilly's trust, an unbreakable bond forms, culminating in Lilly speaking her first words to save Natalia. Just when Natalia finally begins to feel at home, new challenges threaten everything she's fought to build. With Lilly bullied at school and both her old and new families turning against her, Natalia must fight to protect the love, home, and family she never expected to find.

At sixteen, Sofia’s adoptive mother sold her eggs on the black market, stealing her chance to ever become a mother. Years later, Sofia is just a school custodian—until she saves a little girl from a kidnapping and catches the attention of her mysterious billionaire father. Desperate to protect his daughter from a vicious custody battle, he offers Sofia an unexpected deal: marry him. What starts as a fake marriage soon turns into a love neither of them can resist. But his ruthless ex-wife, buried secrets, and deadly betrayals threaten to tear their new family apart. Sofia has already lost her chance at motherhood. Will she lose the family she finally found?
A socially shunned columnist finds his romantic match online, but messaging under the wrong account causes his sleazy roommate's picture to be forwarded, creating an identity mix-up.

title: Spoiled by Four Sea Monster Husbands

source_record.facts: Alice is swept into the undersea world of Atlantis and becomes the mute, wicked supporting character everyone despises: the disgraced princess whose four merman husbands are ready to kill her. A healing pearl regrows her tongue, and the newly activated system sends her on missions to recover her beautiful voice and rebuild her spirit power. Through singing and other spirit-based purification skills, Alice eases the ocean corruption driving her husbands berserk and slowly turns their resentment into trust, affection, and fierce devotion. Soon, Gunnar the shark warrior, Will the irresistible merman, Vincent the sharp-tentacled octopus, and Albert the venomous jellyfish mage - four stunning, chiseled merman husbands - are all competing to protect and spoil her. When a two-faced rival tries to take everything Alice has reclaimed, she gives her enemy a satisfying reality check, turns the tables, and rises from Atlantis’s most unwanted woman to its most adored.
source_record.platform_title: Spoiled by Four Sea Monster Husbands

source_record.facts: After the Iron Sheep Kingdom falls, Prince Leigh is offered to Kaelen, the Blood Lion King cursed by berserker blood, becoming the “remedy” that keeps him alive. Their reunion awakens a bond forged fourteen years ago. From captor and captive to allies, they uncover the truth behind the kingdom’s fall and the curse. After surviving conspiracies, war, and sacrifice, Leigh reclaims his throne and rules alongside Kaelen.

title: The Return of the Supreme One

source_record.facts: At the academy’s grand Midwinter Banquet, Arthur is publicly stripped of his title, humiliated by the wife he spent five years protecting, and replaced by her returning first love.​ To everyone else, he is nothing more than a useless man living off Silverleaf Academy. No one knows the truth—that Arthur once sealed away his godlike power to save the continent, and the academy itself has only survived because of him.​ So when his wife throws him out with nothing left to lose, Arthur finally ends the contract that bound him to humanity.​ And the moment he walks away, the entire kingdom begins to collapse. And the moment he walks away, the entire kingdom begins to collapse.
source_record.platform_title: The Return of the Supreme One

source_record.facts: Mia, a money-driven straight-A student, strikes a deal with Chase—the star quarterback of the school team who’s failing calculus and facing a competition ban—to get revenge on her cheating ex-boyfriend. She will tutor him to pull up his grades, while he pretends to be her boyfriend. Mia lays down strict ground rules: every physical touch comes with an extra charge. As they spend endless days studying together and putting on a fake couple act, undeniable chemistry blooms between them. Chase willingly pays extra for every intimate crossing of their boundaries, and Mia sees past his flashy, cocky exterior to the broken loneliness hidden deep inside him. Their contractual performance slowly blossoms into genuine affection, until their agreement is maliciously leaked, putting their budding love to the ultimate test.

title: A Marriage Deal with the Billionaire

source_record.facts: Khloe has always played by the rules until her sister's life depends on money she doesn't have. So she signs the unthinkable: marry ruthless billionaire Jasper Tate, give him the heir his empire demands, and walk away rich. No feelings. No complications. source_record.facts: Carlos, the legendary shooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for long-distance confirmed kills and then vanished from the public eye. He hides his identity and works as a maintenance technician at a shooting range. There, he endures the humiliations from the club captain, Andre, who despises him without knowing his true identity. The shooting range is about to face a hostile takeover. To protect Joana, the owner, and her daughter Rebeca, Carlos finally decides to act, revealing his legendary shooting skills. His extraordinary performance immediately draws attention to his mysterious identity…

title: She Smashed My Dragon Baby, I Smashed Her Life

source_record.facts: Delaney is the youngest daughter most beloved by the Dragon God, but she falls in love with a human named Dylan. As a test, the Dragon God seals Delaney’s divine powers for three years. During those three years, Delaney, a female CEO, helps Dylan’s company grow into a household-name corporation. To protect Dylan’s pride, she supports him quietly from behind the scenes. In the third year of their marriage, Delaney gives birth to a dragon egg that needs to be hatched, but Dylan becomes involved with Daphne, his secretary who is secretly his mistress. At an auction, Delaney crosses paths with Daphne and the two clash. The dragon egg, on the verge of hatching, becomes the target of Daphne’s jealous rage…
source_record.platform_title: She Smashed My Dragon Baby, I Smashed Her Life

title: Devour to the God of Death from a Stray Dog

source_record.facts: Trash dog’s epic counterattack! Inheriting Anubis’s legacy, he evolves by devouring everything! Tortures villains, protects his master, fights the world-destroying serpent, and finally breaks through to SSS rank as Anubis, becoming a god in one battle!
source_record.platform_title: Devour to the God of Death from a Stray Dog

source_record.facts: A group of female friends reunite for a New Year's Eve celebration but old tensions resurface and past rivalries reignite, causing the night to descend into chaos and sparks and revelations to fly like fireworks.

title: My Strongest Master Likes Acting Weak

source_record.facts: Abe Tatum is a transmigrator and a Great Emperor. But all he wants is a peaceful life and hides his true strength at the Azure Cloud Peak. Too bad his system forces him to take in three misfits——a reincarnated Empress, a troublemaker, and a girl with massive bad luck. He wants to keep a low profile, but keeps getting dragged into conspiracies, revenge, and heavenly karmic backlash. When his home and disciples face absolute peril, Abe Tatum is forced to drop his act.
source_record.platform_title: My Strongest Master Likes Acting Weak
